description.en: We are seeking an experienced Senior Civil Engineer to lead our engineering team in Addis Ababa. You will be responsible for overseeing major infrastructure projects, ensuring quality standards, and mentoring junior engineers. This role requires strong technical expertise and project management skills.
description.am: አዲስ አበባ ውስጥ የምህንድስና ቡድናችንን የሚመሩ ልምድ ያላቸው ከፍተኛ የሲቪል ምህንድስና ባለሙያ እየፈለግን ነው። ዋና ዋና የመሠረተ ልማት ፕሮጀክቶችን የመቆጣጠር፣ የጥራት ደረጃዎችን የማረጋገጥ እና ጀማሪ መሐንዲሶችን የማሰልጠን ሃላፊነት ይኖርዎታል። ይህ ሚና ጠንካራ የቴክኒክ እውቀት እና የፕሮጀክት አስተዳደር ክህሎቶችን ይጠይቃል።
description.om: Nu injineerii Sivilii angafaa muuxannoo qabu kan garee injineerii keenyaa Addis Ababaa keessatti geggeessu barbaanna. Ati porjeektota bu'uuraa ijoo to'achuu, sadarkaa qulqullinaa mirkaneessuu fi injineerota haaraa leenjisuu irratti itti gaafatamaa taata. Hojiin kun ogummaa teekinikaa cimaa fi dandeettii bulchiinsa porjeektii barbaada.

en: Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering or related field
5+ years of experience in civil engineering
Proficiency in engineering software (AutoCAD, Civil 3D, Revit)
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Excellent communication and teamwork abilities
Professional engineering license preferred
Experience with large-scale infrastructure projects

በሲቪል ምህንድስና 5+ ዓመታት ልምድ
በምህንድስና ሶፍትዌሮች (AutoCAD, Civil 3D, Revit) ላይ ብቃት
ጠንካራ የመተንተን እና የችግር አፈታት ክህሎቶች
እጅግ በጣም ጥሩ የመግባቢያ እና የቡድን ስራ ክህሎቶች
የሙያ ምህንድስና ፈቃድ ተመራጭ

om: Digirii Baashiloorii Injineerii Sivilii ykn danaa wal qabatee
Waggaa 5+ injineerii sivilii keessatti muuxannoo
Sofitweerii injineerii (AutoCAD, Civil 3D, Revit) beekuu

description.en: We are looking for an experienced Project Manager to lead our operations in Nairobi. You will oversee multiple construction projects, coordinate with stakeholders, and ensure timely delivery within budget. This role requires strong leadership and strategic planning skills.
description.am: ናይሮቢ ውስጥ ስራዎቻችንን የሚመሩ ልምድ ያላቸው የፕሮጀክት አስተዳዳሪ እየፈለግን ነው። በርካታ የግንባታ ፕሮጀክቶችን ይቆጣጠራሉ፣ ከባለድርሻ አካላት ጋር ያስተባብራሉ እና በጊዜ እና በበጀት ውስጥ መድረስን ያረጋግጣሉ። ይህ ሚና ጠንካራ የአመራር እና የስትራቴጂክ እቅድ አውጪ ክህሎቶችን ይጠይቃል።
description.om: Nu bulchii porjeektii muuxannoo qabu kan hojiirraa keenyaa Nayiroobii keessatti geggeessu barbaanna. Ati porjeektota ijaarsaa hedduu to'achuu, qooda fudhattoota waliin walqabsiisuu fi yeroo fi baajetii keessatti dhiheessuu mirkaneessuu ni qabda. Hojiin kun hoogganaa cimaa fi karoora tarsiimaa kan barbaaduudha.

en: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Construction Management, or related field
7+ years of experience in project management
PMP or similar certification preferred
Strong leadership and organizational skills
Excellent communication and negotiation abilities
Experience with project management software (MS Project, Primavera)
Proven track record of successful project delivery
Knowledge of construction industry standards and regulations
am: በቢዝነስ አስተዳደር፣ በግንባታ አስተዳደር ወይም ተዛማጅ መስክ የባችለር ዲግሪ
በፕሮጀክት አስተዳደር 7+ ዓመታት ልምድ
PMP ወይም ተመሳሳይ የምስክር ወረቀት ተመራጭ

እጅግ በጣም ጥሩ የመግባቢያ እና የመደራደር ክህሎቶች
በፕሮጀክት አስተዳደር ሶፍትዌሮች (MS Project, Primavera) ልምድ
የተሳካ የፕሮጀክት አቅርቦት ሪከርድ
ስለ ግንባታ ኢንዱስትሪ ደረጃዎች እና ደንቦች እውቀት
om: Digirii Baashiloorii Bulchiinsa Daldalaa, Bulchiinsa Ijaarsaa ykn danaa wal qabatee
Waggaa 7+ bulchiinsa porjeektii keessatti muuxannoo
Sertifikeetii PMP ykn kan fakkaatu filatamaa
Dandeettii hoogganuu fi qindeessuu cimaa
Dandeettii qunnamtii fi marii caalaa

Galma bu'aa porjeektii walduraa duubaa
Beekumsa sadarkaa fi seera warshada ijaarsaa

description.en: We are seeking a dedicated Site Supervisor to manage our construction projects in Dar es Salaam. You will be responsible for overseeing daily site operations, ensuring safety compliance, and coordinating with contractors and workers. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with strong leadership skills.
description.am: ዳር ኤስ ሰላም ውስጥ የግንባታ ፕሮጀክቶቻችንን የሚያስተዳድር ታማኝ የጣቢያ ተቆጣጣሪ እየፈለግን ነው። የዕለት ተዕለት የጣቢያ ስራዎችን የመቆጣጠር፣ የደህንነት ደንቦችን የማረጋገጥ እና ከተቋራጮች እና ሰራተኞች ጋር የማስተባበር ሃላፊነት ይኖርዎታል። ይህ ጠንካራ የአመራር ክህሎት ላለው ሰው በጣም ጥሩ እድል ነው።
description.om: Nu to'ataa iddoo of qopheessaa kan porjeektota ijaarsaa keenyaa Daar es Salaam keessatti bulchu barbaanna. Ati hojiilee iddoo guyyuu to'achuu, eegumsa nageenyaa mirkaneessuu fi waraantota fi hojjattoota waliin walqabsiisuu irratti itti gaafatamaa taata. Kun carraa gaarii ta'ee kan nama dandeettii hoogganuu cimaa qabuuf.

en: Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Construction Management or related field
3+ years of experience in construction supervision
Knowledge of construction safety regulations and standards
Strong attention to detail and quality control
Excellent team management and communication skills
First aid and safety certification preferred
Ability to read and interpret construction drawings

ለዝርዝር እና ለጥራት ቁጥጥር ጠንካራ ትኩረት
እጅግ በጣም ጥሩ የቡድን አስተዳደር እና የመግባቢያ ክህሎቶች
የመጀመሪያ እርዳታ እና የደህንነት የምስክር ወረቀት ተመራጭ

om: Diiplomaa ykn Digirii Baashiloorii Bulchiinsa Ijaarsaa ykn danaa wal qabatee

description.en: We are looking for a talented Structural Engineer to join our team in Kampala. You will be responsible for designing and analyzing structural systems for various construction projects. This role requires strong technical skills and attention to detail.

description.om: Nu injineerii caasaa dandeettii qabu kan garee keenyaa Kaampaalaa keessatti seenu barbaanna.
